adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code wraps the HubSpot SDK call in refreshOAuthTokens(). When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response object (lines 7-14 of refreshOAuthTokens.ts). However, the code assigns this directly to `hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken`, expecting it to be the HubSpot token object with accessToken/expiresIn properties. The fetch Response object doesn't have these properties, so the subsequent code that uses hubspotRefreshToken.accessToken would fail. This is a type mismatch bug when credential sync is enabled.
